title: U.S. GOLD CORP. TO PARTICIPATE IN 121 MINING INVESTMENT CONFERENCE IN LONDON, UNITED KINGDOM :: U.S. Gold Corp. (USAU)
body_markdown:
CHEYENNE, Wyo.


, Nov. 18, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- U.S. Gold Corp. (Nasdaq: USAU) (the "Company", "we" "our" or "us"), a U.S. focused gold and copper exploration and development company, is pleased to announce its participation in the 121 Mining Investment Conference (the "Conference"), taking place November 23-24, 2026, in London, United Kingdom. Company President & CEO George Bee and Terri Anne Welyki, Corporate Communications, have two full days of one-on-one meetings at the Conference.


**Event:** 121 Mining Investment Conference in London, UK
**Date:** November 23-24, 2026 - Convene, 133 Houndsditch, London, EC3A 7BX
**Registration** :[Registration](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4825748-1&h=731034918&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4557320-1%26h%3D3975533140%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Flondon.121mininginvestment.com%252Fpage%252Finvestor-registration%26a%3DRegistration&a=Registration)


**About U.S. Gold Corp.**


U.S. Gold Corp. is a publicly traded, U.S.-focused gold and copper exploration and development company. The Company has a portfolio of exploration properties. The flagship CK Gold Project is located in southeast Wyoming. The Keystone exploration property is on the Cortez Trend in Nevada. The Challis Gold Project is located in Idaho. For more information, visit[www.usgoldcorp.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4825748-1&h=101596949&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.usgoldcorp.com%2F&a=www.usgoldcorp.com) .
